 Ukrainian Cup. Shakhtar – Dynamo: kick-off time
 20.10.2026, 18:12 
 Print 
 Share: 
 In the Round of 16 of the 2025/2026 Ukrainian Cup, Dynamo Kyiv will face Shakhtar Donetsk.
 The match, in which the White-Blues will be the away team, will take place on Tuesday, October 27, in Lviv at Arena Lviv.
 Kick-off is scheduled for 18:00.
